value.rationale: The complete sign frame is a canonical natural measurement system with unavoidable real coordinate ambiguities despite exponential oversampling. Beyond the already-known general theorem ensuring existence of suitably many generic extra frame vectors, it identifies every such ambiguity, gives an explicit necessary-and-sufficient description of all successful single rows for every dimension, and determines the exact, attained, scale-homogeneous margin measuring the repair of those collisions. This structural completeness and quantitative degeneration at repeated anchor magnitudes are motivated independently of computation, not a routine name change or an arbitrary finite slice.
